title: Prisma $queryRaw Concatenation in a JSON API
learning_objectives: Distinguish Prisma's safe $queryRaw tagged template from the raw string concat of $queryRawUnsafe
Inject through a JSON request-body value rather than a URL query parameter
Break out of a string literal and append a UNION SELECT that matches arity and column types
Exfiltrate a row id from a confidential table and turn it into the solve token
flag_hint: /solve reads the flag from /flag.txt when the submitted id matches the seeded audit-log row id.
inspired_by: Snyk's 2024 research on Prisma $queryRawUnsafe misuse across GitHub, plus PortSwigger UNION-based SQL injection
